author: wittjosiah
principle: Never use `as any` (or another silencing cast) to make a build pass; fix the underlying type error at its source instead.
fix_shape: remove the cast and resolve the real type mismatch (e.g. with proper function overloads).

author: wittjosiah
principle: Only use a composite component's sub-parts within their Root, and only use `asChild` where there is exactly one immediate child element for it to merge props onto.
fix_shape: wrap the sub-part in its Root and ensure `asChild` has a single element child.

author: wittjosiah
principle: When a schema drives an auto-generated form, order the schema's fields in the order they should appear in the UI, not arbitrarily.
fix_shape: reorder the schema struct's fields to match the intended form field order.

author: wittjosiah
principle: When a generic type parameter is meant to accept any entity (object or relation), bound/default it to the union type (e.g. Type.Entity.Any) rather than only the object-specific type (Type.Obj.Any).
fix_shape: widen the generic bound/default from Type.Obj.Any to Type.Entity.Any.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not fall back to `any` for a generic type parameter's default when a more specific existing type would already serve as the default.
fix_shape: use the existing, more specific type (e.g. AnyProperties) as the generic default instead of any.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Justify with an explicit comment any pattern that has performance implications when used inside a hot, interactive component (e.g. a form that re-renders on every keystroke); do not add it silently.
fix_shape: add a comment explaining why the pattern is needed there, or remove it if it isn't.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Wrap handler functions passed as props or used in dependency arrays with useCallback to avoid unnecessary re-creation and re-renders.
fix_shape: memoize the handler with useCallback.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Write build artifacts that must not ship in the published package to a directory excluded from publishing, not into the default output directory that gets published.
fix_shape: point the build/upload step at a separate (e.g. `out`) directory outside the published `dist`.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Move logic that is not about rendering out of a React component and into a hook or plain function.
fix_shape: extract the non-rendering logic into a hook/utility and call it from the component.
